summary: preinstall hook fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at install time, stages the binary to a tempdir with execute permission, and uses it to run a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped at the tarball root. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNNNN` identifiers and per-function property dictionaries in the loader; a 727 KB payload with a string-array rotator `WV8StW`, a large mixed hex/string dictionary, and `with` statements to defeat parsers in the executed file). The package advertises only static webfonts/CSS assets — `dist/` contains only css/less/scss/fonts and the README documents font installation — so fetching an alternate language runtime to execute an obfuscated `math_init.js` has no relation to the stated purpose. The published tarball declares `"files": ["dist", "readme.md"]` in package.json, but `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` sit at the tarball root outside that manifest while being wired into preinstall. Fetching an alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload bypasses Node-based analyzers and yields arbitrary code execution on the installer's host on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
